objective: Implement and verify QIF v0.8.3 Portable Knowledge Supply-Chain Revocation

assignment.assignment_reason: Builder owns the bounded qif-ledger revocation schema, dependency traversal verifier, retained fixtures, documentation, and release slice

capability_fit.rationale: existing portable import, local validation, and cross-reference architecture support bounded revocation lineage

required_sections: revocation notices, dependency edges, impact assessments, and revalidation decisions
acceptance_criteria: npm test passes all positive and retained negative fixtures
portable package verifies and release assets match v0.8.3

review_criteria.criterion: revocation impact is exact, transitive, history-preserving, and fail-closed
review_criteria.evidence_required: schema constants, deterministic traversal, example, and rejecting fixtures

review_criteria.criterion: revalidation requires reviewed replacement evidence and cannot grant activation or authority
review_criteria.evidence_required: schema, validator rules, governance triggers, and fixtures

blocker_semantics.trigger_condition: an active or disputed notice can leave a dependent eligibility unsuspended, omit a transitive dependency, delete history, or revalidate without reviewed evidence
blocker_semantics.recovery_action: add deterministic fail-closed rule and rejecting fixture

hri_projection.next_action: Run Guardian review and full release validation
